comments.syntax: The model contains multiple syntax errors. Two start events (0, 1) cannot converge into a single gateway (2). An exclusive gateway (25) has two outgoing flows to the same element type (intermediate catch events 26, 30), which is redundant and confusing. The model contains multiple deadlocks, for example, after the parallel split at gateway 24, the path through gateway 25 never merges back with the path through gateway 35. Similarly, the main parallel split at gateway 3 creates a path for private insurance reporting that never synchronizes with the employer reporting path, leaving a dangling token. The model is not well-formed due to numerous unmatched gateways and unclear process paths.

It also invents a distinction between reporting to the Labour Inspectorate ('Arbeitsinspektorat') and 'Sicherheitsbehörden' (security authorities), treating them as separate, parallel reports, which is unsupported by the text.
